2607.00970.title: Svarna: An Open Corpus Workbench for Modern Greek
2607.00970.paper_summary: This paper introduces Svarna, a free, open-source, web-based corpus workbench for modern Greek. Svarna integrates five databases covering various registers, institutional, literary, dialectal, social media, and historical, to provide a total of more than 507 million words and around 29 million sentences. This platform addresses the chronic gaps in Greek language technology. Although various corpus resources exist, they are scattered across different platforms, and in many cases, institutional access is restricted or they are no longer available online. Svarna integrates these resources into a single interface that can be used without logging in, installation, or specialized training. This system provides a concordancer with KWIC marking capabilities, frequency analysis including register-by-register normalization, collocation extraction using mutual information, a dictionary of 93 Greek discourse markers providing distribution profiles, text-level analysis tools including n-grams, variants, and collocation networks, register comparison using log-ratio, regular expression search, and an optional LLM layer for pragmatic annotation and free research mode. This platform is built upon SQLite FTS5 full-text indexes provided via a FastAPI backend, deployed as Docker containers on Azure, and released under the MIT license. Source code, build scripts, and deployment configurations are publicly available on GitHub. Users can add their own corpora and deploy their own instances. This document describes the system design, corpus structure, and use cases demonstrating the various queries supported by the platform. Svarna serves as the first step in exploring available data and is expected to lay the foundation for more comprehensive research in the future.
2607.00970.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文介紹了Svarna，一個免費、開源的基於網頁的現代希臘語語料庫工作平台。Svarna整合了五個數據庫，涵蓋各種語域，包括機構、文學、方言、社交媒體和歷史，提供超過5.07億個單詞和約2900萬個句子。這個平台解決了希臘語言技術中的長期缺口。儘管存在各種語料資源，但它們散佈在不同的平台上，並且在許多情況下，機構訪問受到限制或者不再在線提供。Svarna將這些資源整合到一個單一的界面中，無需登錄、安裝或專業培訓即可使用。這個系統提供了一個具有KWIC標記功能的協調器、包括按語域正規化的頻率分析、使用互信息的搭配提取、提供分佈概況的93個希臘語話語標記的詞典、包括n-grams、變體和搭配網絡的文本級分析工具、使用對數比進行的語域比較、正則表達式搜索，以及用於語用標註和自由研究模式的可選LLM層。這個平台建立在通過FastAPI後端提供的SQLite FTS5全文索引之上，作為Docker容器在Azure上部署，並以MIT許可證發布。源代碼、構建腳本和部署配置在GitHub上公開可用。用戶可以添加自己的語料庫並部署自己的實例。本文檔描述了系統設計、語料結構和用例，展示了平台支持的各種查詢。Svarna作為探索可用數據的第一步，預計將為未來更全面的研究奠定基礎。
